meta.scope: Full stack — Edge Functions, RLS, Frontend, Auth, Billing, Config

critical_issues.issue: No admin verification before executing privileged commands
critical_issues.detail: Any authenticated user could call run_neeko_pipeline, admin_update_fantasy_prices, admin_update_player_status, admin_toggle_team_bye without any role check. Service role key used without verifying caller identity.
critical_issues.fix_applied: Added two-step server-side guard: auth.getUser() to validate JWT, then get_access_state() RPC to confirm is_admin = true. 403 returned for non-admins.

critical_issues.issue: Premium content rendered in DOM when locked
critical_issues.detail: Children were wrapped in className='invisible pointer-events-none select-none'. Content was present in DOM — accessible via browser DevTools, scrapers, and automation tools. Anyone could read premium AI analysis without a subscription.
critical_issues.fix_applied: Locked state now renders only the CTA element. Children are not mounted to the DOM at all when locked=true.

high_issues.issue: Policy named 'Admins can read system state' had qual:true — all authenticated users could read
high_issues.detail: The RLS policy check was a literal TRUE expression, not an admin guard. Any logged-in user could read operator flags, pipeline lock states, and internal configuration.
high_issues.fix_applied: Migration fix_rls_system_state_admin_guard: dropped broken policy, replaced with EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM profiles WHERE id=auth.uid() AND is_admin=true)

high_issues.issue: Policy 'Service role manages queue' was on authenticated role — all authenticated users could read AI job queue
high_issues.detail: The policy was defined on the authenticated role with SELECT true. Any logged-in user could read pending AI generation jobs including player IDs, prompt payloads, and processing state.
high_issues.fix_applied: Migration fix_rls_ai_generation_queue_service_role_only: restricted to service_role only with a separate admin-read policy

high_issues.issue: No HTTP security headers set on any response
high_issues.detail: vercel.json had no headers section. Missing: Content-Security-Policy, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Strict-Transport-Security, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, X-XSS-Protection.
high_issues.fix_applied: Added full header set to vercel.json. CSP scoped to self + Supabase + Stripe + PostHog + Vercel Insights. HSTS 2-year with preload. X-Frame-Options DENY.
high_issues.note: vercel.json was also malformed (duplicate headers key) — fixed to single valid JSON object

high_issues.issue: Hardcoded email-based admin shortcut bypassing role check
high_issues.detail: ADMIN_EMAIL = 'neekotrading@gmail.com' was used to short-circuit the DB role check. Email comparison for authorization is fragile and inconsistent with the rest of the codebase.
high_issues.fix_applied: Removed ADMIN_EMAIL constant and email comparison entirely. Admin check now uses get_access_state() RPC exclusively.

high_issues.issue: Anonymous users could INSERT unlimited start/sit decision rows
high_issues.detail: Policy 'Anyone can insert start/sit decisions' allowed anon role to write with_check:true. Enabled unauthenticated table flooding and fake decision injection.
high_issues.fix_applied: Migration fix_rls_start_sit_decisions_restrict_anon_insert: INSERT restricted to authenticated users only. SELECT remains public for social proof.
high_issues.note: Residual issue: old 'Anyone can insert start_sit decisions' anon policy still exists (was not dropped). Recommend DROP POLICY IF EXISTS 'Anyone can insert start_sit decisions' ON public.start_sit_decisions in next pass.

medium_issues.issue: Massive duplicate policy proliferation — up to 18 policies on a single table
medium_issues.detail: weekly_content_posts had 18 active policies (4 DELETE, 3 INSERT, 4 SELECT, 3 UPDATE plus service_role duplicates). weekly_content_plans had 9. Creates ambiguity and maintenance risk. Also found auth.role()='service_role' pattern on public role — anti-pattern.
medium_issues.fix_applied: Migration fix_rls_duplicate_policies_weekly_content: dropped all duplicates, replaced with canonical set (service_role ALL + 4 admin operations each)
medium_issues.note: Residual: Some legacy duplicates may still exist due to incomplete DROP coverage — verify with pg_policies query

medium_issues.issue: Internal error.message returned directly to clients
medium_issues.detail: Multiple edge functions return err.message or error.message directly to the calling client. This can expose database schema, Supabase internal error codes, and stack details.
medium_issues.recommendation: Wrap error returns in generic messages: return { error: 'Internal server error' } and log details server-side only

medium_issues.issue: In-memory rate limiter (3 req/10s) — not persistent, bypassable, per-instance only
medium_issues.detail: Rate limiting state is held in a Map in function memory. Each cold start resets limits. Multiple function instances don't share state. x-forwarded-for header used for anonymous callers — spoofable.
medium_issues.recommendation: Implement rate limiting via a Redis-backed approach or use Supabase DB with TTL-indexed rows for persistent cross-instance rate limiting

medium_issues.issue: Return URL constructed from request origin without allowlist validation
medium_issues.detail: Line 78: return_url uses the incoming origin header. If the CORS allowlist is ever relaxed, this could enable open redirects via the Stripe portal flow.
medium_issues.recommendation: Hardcode return_url to known domain values rather than using origin header

medium_issues.issue: Any authenticated or anonymous user can insert analytics events
medium_issues.detail: Policy 'Anyone can insert analytics events' allows anon+authenticated INSERT with_check:true. Could be used to inject fake analytics, skew funnel metrics, or generate noise.
medium_issues.recommendation: Consider rate-limiting analytics inserts via an edge function wrapper, or restrict to authenticated only

medium_issues.issue: Multiple duplicate service_role ALL policies on same tables
medium_issues.detail: system_state has 'Service role can manage system state' AND 'Service role full access to system_state'. player_prices has 'Service role full access player_prices' AND 'Service role full player_prices'. weekly_content_posts has 3 service_role ALL policies.
medium_issues.recommendation: Remove duplicate service_role policies — only one is needed per table

medium_issues.issue: Legacy auth.role() = 'service_role' pattern on public role
medium_issues.detail: Policies named service_role_full_access_plans/posts are on the 'public' role and use USING (auth.role() = 'service_role'). This is an anti-pattern — auth.role() is not reliable for row-level enforcement. Use TO service_role instead.
medium_issues.recommendation: Drop the auth.role() based policies and rely on the correct TO service_role policies already present

medium_issues.issue: Only one policy (authenticated SELECT) — no service_role write policy visible
medium_issues.detail: Policy named 'Service role full access' is actually on the authenticated role with SELECT true — a misleadingly named policy. No INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE policies for the service_role are visible.
medium_issues.recommendation: Add explicit service_role ALL policy. Verify the table is correctly writable from the pipeline.

medium_issues.issue: limit_players parameter has no upper bound validation
medium_issues.detail: User-supplied limit_players is passed without capping. Could be used to trigger extremely large AI generation batches.

medium_issues.issue: OpenAI API key not validated for existence before use
medium_issues.detail: OPENAI_API_KEY is read from env but never checked for null/undefined before the function starts processing jobs.
medium_issues.recommendation: Add early guard: if (!openAiKey) return error response immediately

medium_issues.issue: storage.buckets has 0 RLS policies — bucket table is unprotected
medium_issues.detail: storage.objects has 3 policies but storage.buckets has 0. Bucket enumeration may be possible via the anon key depending on Supabase storage defaults.
medium_issues.recommendation: Verify storage bucket visibility settings in Supabase dashboard and confirm content_assets bucket is private

medium_issues.issue: Residual 'Anyone can insert start_sit decisions' anon+authenticated policy still active alongside new restricted policy
medium_issues.detail: The previous fix added a new authenticated-only INSERT policy but the old anon INSERT policy 'Anyone can insert start_sit decisions' was not successfully dropped. Both policies are active — the permissive model means the less restrictive one wins.
medium_issues.recommendation: Run: DROP POLICY IF EXISTS 'Anyone can insert start_sit decisions' ON public.start_sit_decisions

medium_issues.issue: Only admin-authenticated policies, no service_role ALL policy
medium_issues.detail: All 3 policies on fantasy_player_market require authenticated admin. If the pipeline needs to write to this table as service_role, it will be blocked.
medium_issues.recommendation: Add service_role ALL policy if pipeline writes to this table

medium_issues.detail: Webhook endpoints are called server-to-server and don't need CORS at all. The wildcard origin is not a direct security risk but violates least-privilege.
medium_issues.recommendation: Consider removing CORS headers from webhook endpoint entirely, or restricting to stripe.com

low_issues.issue: vercel.json had duplicate headers key — malformed JSON
low_issues.detail: The file had two 'headers' keys (JSON spec: last one wins). The first entry was an empty object. Fixed in this session.
low_issues.fix_applied: vercel.json rewritten to single valid JSON object

low_issues.issue: index.js chunk is 812 KB minified (239 KB gzip)
low_issues.detail: Not a security issue but large bundles increase attack surface and slow loading. Vite flagged chunks over 500 KB.
low_issues.recommendation: Add dynamic import() splitting for admin pages and large feature modules

low_issues.detail: If the webhook URL env var is missing, alerts fail silently without error logging.
low_issues.recommendation: Add explicit log warning when webhook URL is missing

low_issues.issue: No anon SELECT policy — only authenticated can read
low_issues.detail: This is intentional (signals are premium data) but worth documenting explicitly.

passed_checks.check: .env only contains VITE_SUPABASE_URL and VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY — both public by design, no service role key
Service role key only accessed via Deno.env.get() inside edge functions — never in client bundle
Stripe secret key only in edge function env — not in .env or any frontend file
RequireAdmin uses server-authoritative get_access_state() RPC — not localStorage or client-mutable state
RequireAuth redirects unauthenticated users before any data loads
auth.tsx isAdmin and isPremium both sourced from get_access_state() RPC — cannot be spoofed client-side
stripe-webhook verifies Stripe signature via constructEventAsync — webhook forgery not possible
stripe_customers, stripe_subscriptions, stripe_webhook_events, payments — all service_role only writes
Users can only read their own stripe_customers row (profile_id = auth.uid() OR user_id = auth.uid())
stripe-checkout validates JWT via getUser() before creating session
All 89 audited tables have RLS enabled — no table found with rowsecurity=false
Admin tables (admin_tasks, pipeline_runs, pipeline_steps, system_logs) — admin-only read, service_role write
profiles table — users can only read/update own row (auth.uid() = id)
ai_generation_queue — now correctly service_role only after fix
system_state — now admin-gated after fix
afl.games, afl.players, afl.teams, afl.player_games — public read, service_role write (correct for stats data)
app_config — deny all for public role + service_role only. Well hardened.
market schema tables — public read, service_role write (correct for market watch data)
admin-health — proper dual-auth (service key OR admin user check via profiles.is_admin)
afl-master-dispatcher — verifies token === serviceKey before any pipeline operations
generate-ai-worker — verifies token === serviceKey
portal — validates JWT via getUser() before creating Stripe portal session
pipeline-alerts — verifies token === serviceRoleKey
admin-command — now has full server-side admin verification after fix
PipelineHistory — admin check now uses get_access_state() RPC only after fix
PremiumGate — premium content no longer mounted to DOM when locked after fix
vercel.json — full HTTP security header set applied after fix
CORS on admin-command and admin-health restricted to neekostats.com.au domain
PKCE auth flow with localStorage — standard Supabase pattern, no issue
Auth sign-out uses global scope (clears all sessions)

recommendations.action: Drop residual anon INSERT policy on start_sit_decisions
recommendations.sql: DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Anyone can insert start_sit decisions" ON public.start_sit_decisions;

recommendations.action: Drop auth.role() based policies on weekly_content_plans and weekly_content_posts
recommendations.sql: DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "service_role_full_access_plans" ON public.weekly_content_plans; DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "service_role_full_access_posts" ON public.weekly_content_posts;

recommendations.action: Drop duplicate service_role policies on system_state and player_prices
recommendations.sql: DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Service role full access to system_state" ON public.system_state; DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Service role full player_prices" ON afl.player_prices;

recommendations.action: Fix ai_rankings_player_recos — rename misleading policy and add service_role write
recommendations.sql: DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Service role full access" ON public.ai_rankings_player_recos; CREATE POLICY "Authenticated read ai rankings recos" ON public.ai_rankings_player_recos FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (true); CREATE POLICY "Service role manages ai rankings recos" ON public.ai_rankings_player_recos FOR ALL TO service_role USING (true) WITH CHECK (true);

recommendations.action: Add upper bound validation in generate-player-ai for limit_players parameter
Replace error.message direct returns with generic messages in edge functions
Verify content_assets storage bucket is set to private in Supabase dashboard
recommendations.detail: storage.buckets table has 0 RLS policies — confirm via dashboard

recommendations.action: Implement persistent rate limiting for generate-start-sit
recommendations.detail: Current in-memory rate limiter resets on cold start and does not work across instances
